items.sum: Veteran actor Nana Patekar appeared in just two Tamil films during his career: the 2008 murder mystery Bommalattam directed by Bharathiraja, and the 2018 Rajinikanth starrer Kaala. In Bommalattam, his dialogues were dubbed by Nizhalgal Ravi, but in Pa. Ranjith's Kaala, Patekar dubbed his own lines in Tamil to play the antagonist Hari Dada. Following news of Patekar's death, Rajinikanth posted a tribute on X, writing, "I can’t believe my dear friend Nanaji is no longer with us."

items.title: Sivakarthikeyan Announces He Will Do Only Mass Commercial Films From Now; Shares Updates on 'Seyon' and 'SK27'
items.sum: Actor Sivakarthikeyan announced at a Chennai event that he will exclusively do mass commercial entertainers hereafter. He provided production updates on two ongoing projects, SK26 titled Seyon and SK27. Seyon, directed by Sivakumar Murugesan, has finished sixty per cent of its shoot including songs, with only a few action sequences left. Meanwhile, his collaboration with Parking director Ramkumar Balakrishnan commenced its first schedule in September with an opening fight and song.

items.title: Karthik Subbaraj’s Next Feature Starring Prabhu Deva, Atharvaa, and Upendra Headed Directly to Netflix
items.sum: Filmmaker Karthik Subbaraj revealed that his next directorial project will premiere directly on Netflix. The untitled film stars Prabhu Deva, Atharvaa, and Upendra in the lead roles. Subbaraj stated that the plot is based on the traditional Tamil folk dance Puliyaattam and is adapted from a novel. The first schedule of shooting is already complete, with the next schedule slated for the second week of next month. "Netflix has been involved with the project right from the beginning," Subbaraj noted regarding the streaming release.

Vijay has opened Tamil Nadu politics to a new breed of cinema heroes
items.sum: TVK leader Vijay launched his political party on February 2, 2024, altering Tamil Nadu's political landscape and shifting power toward cinema heroes. Vijay's strategy aims to weaken the DMK first family's control over the film industry and sideline the party politically. This shift has encouraged other contemporary actors to engage in social welfare outreach and education. Traditional political leaders like MK Stalin and Edappadi Palaniswami now face rising concern as actors move into politics. Meanwhile, TVK's official policies embrace a spiritual posture, marking a departure from traditional atheist Dravidianism.
